Singular-value spectra. The figure uses molecular layers layer 1, layer 2. Lines and points
show ordered raw-assay singular values for layer traces: layer 1, layer 2. The dashed
horizontal line marks the BBP reference at 11.89. The analysis unit is independent biological
observation; the design is cross-sectional; the estimand is the raw, uncentred assay
singular-value spectrum of each molecular layer. The BBP line uses (n x p)^(1/4) from the first
layer under a spiked white-noise model; it is a model-based detectability reference, not
empirical proof. Position relative to this reference does not establish recovery or biological
validity of an axis.
